title: The Fan Quits
lines: Max is in bed and a big fan hums.
But the fan quits and Max hops up.
"The fan is bad!" said Max. He is mad.
Dad pats it. It hums, but it quits.
Dad tips a jug and gets a mug.
Max sips. Dad gets a red cap.
Dad fans him, and Max hugs him and naps.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
